title: Reconstructed index build records
description: ops/index-history.json: what built each index version released before releases recorded it (#161), by version, as scripts/reconstruct-index-history.py writes it. The API serves an entry as the version's build in /v1/versions (crates/usnm-api/src/versions.rs). Checked in CI by scripts/check-index-history.py, which also checks what a schema can't (keys sorted, the image pushed before the run started).

feature.description: The feature's version constant in usnm-core at the commit; null where the commit has none.

sha256.description: Of the index template at the commit; null where the commit has no such file.

commit.description: The commit of the last usnewsmap-ingest image pushed before the execution started.

engine.description: The Quickwit version Dockerfile.ingest pins at the commit.

execution.description: The ingest job execution the run ran in.

full.description: A full rebuild, not an incremental release.

ingest.description: The usnm-ingest crate version at the commit.

reconstructed.description: How the record was worked out.

run_started_at.description: The run's start, to the nanosecond: the API gives the record only to the run with this exact start, since version names repeat across environments.

templates.description: The index templates' sha256: pages, and pages-ja once releases built a Japanese index.
